title: Find Short-Video Hooks That Already Win
summary: Study the openings that beat their own channel in your niche, then write scored hooks for your own idea before you film.

money_potential.label: Low

money_potential.note: Value tiers are our rough estimates (labelled Estimate) of relative value to the business, each with its assumption. They are not promises, income claims or advice. Results depend on your market, offer and effort.

steps.name: You
steps.does: Picks a hook and films it

steps: Name your niche and the idea you want to film.
Read the hooks that beat their channels and the shared pattern.
Pick the top scored hooks and say them in your own voice.
guardrails: A hook that beats a channel average is a pattern, not a guarantee.
Do not copy other creators' lines word for word.
